detailed_courses.title: Programming for Problem Solving using C
detailed_courses.prerequisite: The prerequisite for Programming for Problem Solving using C is basic knowledge of mathematics and logical reasoning skills.

modules.title: Fundamentals of Computer
modules.content: History of Computer, Generation of Computer, Classification of Computers, Basic structure of Computer System, Primary & Secondary Memory, Processing Unit, Input & Output devices. Number System: basic of Binary, Octal, Decimal and Hexadecimal number systems; Representation and interchanging of number in different number systems. Introduction to complements system, Representation of signed and unsigned numbers in singed magnitude singed 1’s complement system and signed 2’s complement system. Arithmetic– Addition and Subtraction (using1’s complement and, 2’scomplement). Representation of Characters-ASCII Code Basics of Compiler, Interpreter and Assembler Problem solving – Basic concept of Algorithm. Representation of algorithm using flow chart and pseudo code. Some basic examples.

modules.title: Introduction to C Programming
modules.content: Overview of Procedural vs Structural language; History of C Programming Language. Variable and Data Types: The C characterize identifiers. And keywords, data type & sizes, variable names, declaration, statements. Operators & Expressions: Arithmetic operators, relational operators, logical operators, increment and decrement operators, bitwise operators, assignment operators, conditional operators, ternary operator, special operators-type conversion, C expressions, precedence and associativity. Input and Output: Standard input and output, formatted output–print f, formatted input scan f.

modules.title: Branch and Loop
modules.content: Branching: Concept of Statement and Blocks in C, Simple if, if -else, nested if-else and if-else ladder. Switch Case, nested switch statement, break and continue statement; switch-case, concept of go to statement and Loops - while, for, and do while; Concept of nested loop.

modules.title: Program Structures
modules.content: Function: Basics of Functions, function types, function prototypes, formal and actual parameter, function calling, functions returning values, functions not returning values. Recursion and Recursive Function, call by value and call by reference. Storage Class in C: Storage Class-auto, external, static and register storage class, scope rules and lifetime of variables C pre-processor: Pre-processing directive and macro, parameterized macro.

modules.title: Array and Pointer
modules.content: Arrays: One dimensional array, Two-dimensional arrays, Passing an array to a function Pointers: Pointers, Pointer and Array, Pointer and functions. Strings: Character array and string, array of strings, Passing a string to a function, String related functions, Pointer and String. Dynamic memory allocation: Malloc, calloc, realloc and free with example.

modules.title: Structures, Unions and Enum
modules.content: Basic of structures, arrays of structures, structures and pointers, bit fields. Basics of union and Enum, difference between structure and union.

modules.title: File in C
modules.content: Files handling- opening and closing a file in different mode, formatted and unformatted files, command line arguments, f open, f close, f get c, f put c, f print f, f scan f function.

modules.title: Database Concepts and Data Modeling (8L)
modules.content: Introduction to DBMS vs File Systems, Advantages of DBMS, Database Approach, DBMS Architecture: Logical & Physical, Three-level schema, Role of DBA, Data Dictionary and Indexing, Relational Model: Tuples, Domains, Relations, Keys (Super, Candidate, Primary, Foreign), Relational Constraints: Domain, Key, Integrity, and updates Relational Algebra: Basic operations (Selection, Projection, Union, Set Difference, Cartesian Product) Relational Calculus: Tuple Relational Calculus (TRC) and Domain Relational Calculus (DRC). Entity–Relationship Model: Entities, Attributes, Relationships, Conversion of ER diagram to relational schema.

modules.title: Database Integrity and Normalization (7L)
modules.content: Database Integrity: Entity and Referential Integrity, Redundancy and dependency issues, Functional Dependencies, Normalization: 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF, 4NF, 5NF, Multivalued Dependency, Lossless-Join and Dependency Preservation.

modules.title: File Organization and Storage (4L)
modules.content: Physical Database Design Issues, Storage Structures: Heap files, Sequential, Indexed, Hashed organizations, Indexing structures: Tree-based indexes, Multi-key file organization, Inverted and Multi-list file organization, Multiple access paths.

modules.title: Structured Query Language (SQL) (7L)
modules.content: SQL Fundamentals: DDL, DML, DCL, TCL, Queries with WHERE, ORDER BY, GROUP BY, Nested queries, Joins: Inner, Outer, and Self Joins, Views, Indexes, Sequences, Synonyms, Table handling operations.

modules.title: Transaction Processing and Concurrency Control (8L)
modules.content: Transactions and Concurrent Transactions, Serializable Schedules and Locking Protocols, Two-Phase Locking (2PL), Deadlock Detection and Prevention, Optimistic and Pessimistic Concurrency Control, Database Recovery: Failures, Backup & Recovery techniques, Database Security and Authorization.

modules.title: PL/SQL Programming (6L)
modules.content: Introduction to PL/SQL, Variables, Data types, and Basic blocks, Conditional and Iterative Constructs, Cursors and Exception Handling, Stored Procedures, Functions, Triggers, and Packages.

detailed_courses.title: Computer Organization and Architecture
detailed_courses.prerequisite: Concept of basic components of a digital computer, Basic concept of Fundamentals & Program structures.

modules.title: Digital Principles
modules.content: Digital signals, digital logic, digital computers, Von Neumann architecture; Boolean laws and theorems; K-Map (2–4 variables), don’t-care, SOP/POS.

modules.title: Number Systems & Codes
modules.content: Decimal, binary, octal, hexadecimal; conversions; binary arithmetic; BCD addition/subtraction; octal/hex arithmetic; binary/decimal codes; error detecting/correcting codes; ASCII, EBCDIC, Excess-3, Gray code.

modules.title: Combinational Circuits
modules.content: Half/full adders, subtractors, decoders, encoders, multiplexers, demultiplexers.

modules.title: Sequential Circuits
modules.content: Latches and flip-flops (SR, D, JK, T, JK master-slave).

modules.title: Registers & Counters
modules.content: 4-bit registers with parallel load; shift registers (bi-directional with parallel load); 4-bit synchronous/asynchronous binary counters.

modules.title: Basic Computer Organization & Design
modules.content: Instruction codes; computer registers/instructions; timing and control; instruction cycle; memory- reference instructions; I/O interrupt; complete computer description; design of basic computer; accumulator logic.

modules.title: Central Processing Unit
modules.content: General register organization; stack organization; instruction formats; addressing modes; data transfer/manipulation; program control; RISC vs CISC.

modules.title: Pipeline & Vector Processing
modules.content: Parallel processing; pipelining; arithmetic pipeline; instruction pipeline; RISC pipeline.

modules.title: Input–Output Organization
modules.content: Peripheral devices; I/O interface; asynchronous data transfer; modes of transfer; priority interrupt; DMA; I/O processor (IOP).

modules.title: Memory Organization
modules.content: Memory hierarchy: main/auxiliary/associative memory; cache memory; virtual memory; memory management hardware.

detailed_courses.title: Discrete Mathematics and Graph Theory
detailed_courses.prerequisite: The prerequisite for this course is a solid understanding of high school–level algebra and basic logical reasoning skills.

modules.title: Logic and Proofs
modules.content: Propositional logic, Propositional equivalences, Predicates and quantifiers, Nested quantifiers, Rules of inference

modules.title: Principles of Mathematical Induction
modules.content: The Well-Ordering Principle, Recursive definition, The Division algorithm: Prime Numbers, The Greatest Common Divisor: Euclidean Algorithm, The Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic.

modules.title: Sets and Sequence
modules.content: Sets, Relation and Function: Operations and Laws of Sets, Cartesian Products, Binary Relation, Partial Ordering Relation, Equivalence Relation, Image of a Set, Sum and Product of Functions, Bijective functions, Inverse and Composite Function, Size of a Set, Finite and infinite Sets, Countable and uncountable Sets, Cantor's diagonal argument and The Power Set theorem, Schroeder-Bernstein theorem. Fuzzy set, Basic properties of fuzzy set.

modules.title: Counting and Combinatorics
modules.content: Counting, Sum and product rule, Principle of Inclusion Exclusion. Pigeon Hole Principle, Counting by Bijections. Double Counting. Linear Recurrence relations - methods of solutions. Generating Functions. Permutations and Combination

modules.title: Algebraic Structure
modules.content: Algebraic Structures with one Binary Operation, Semi Groups, Monoids, Groups, Congruence Relation and Quotient Structures, Free and Cyclic Monoids and Groups, Permutation Groups, Substructures, Normal Subgroups, Algebraic Structures with two Binary Operation, Rings, Integral Domain and Fields. Boolean Algebra and Boolean Ring, Identities of Boolean Algebra, Duality, Representation of Boolean Function, Disjunctive and Conjunctive Normal Form

modules.title: Graph and Tree
modules.content: Graphs and their properties, Degree, Connectivity, Path, Cycle, Sub Graph, Isomorphism, Eulerian and Hamiltonian Walks, Graph Colouring, Colouring maps and Planar Graphs, Colouring Vertices, Colouring Edges, List Colouring, Perfect Graph, definition properties and Example, rooted trees, trees and sorting, weighted trees and prefix codes, Bi-connected component and Articulation Points, Shortest distances

detailed_courses.title: Environment and Ecology
detailed_courses.prerequisite: Basic understanding of natural sciences and general awareness of environmental issues

modules.title: Introduction to Environment
modules.content: Definition, scope, and importance of environment; Components of environment – biotic and abiotic; Environmental degradation and its causes.

modules.title: Ecology and Ecosystem Concepts
modules.content: Elements of ecology; Ecological balance and consequences of change; Structure and function of ecosystems; Principles of environmental impact assessment (EIA).

modules.title: Air Pollution and Control
modules.content: Composition of atmosphere, energy balance, weather and climate; Sources and effects of air pollutants; Primary and secondary pollutants; Greenhouse effect; Ozone layer depletion; Air quality standards; Control measures.

modules.title: Water Pollution and Control
modules.content: Hydrosphere and natural water composition; Water pollutants – sources and effects; River, lake, and groundwater pollution; Standards and control methods for water pollution.

modules.title: Land Pollution and Waste Management
modules.content: Lithosphere and soil composition; Pollutants from municipal, industrial, commercial, and agricultural sources; Hazardous solid wastes; Collection and disposal methods; Waste recovery and conversion techniques.

modules.title: Noise Pollution and Control
modules.content: Sources and effects of noise; Standards of noise levels; Noise control and mitigation techniques

detailed_courses.title: Management and Accountancy
detailed_courses.prerequisite: The prerequisite for Management and Accountancy is a basic understanding of business fundamentals and elementary knowledge of mathematics.

modules.title: Introduction to Management
modules.content: Nature, meaning, and importance of management, Evolution of management thought – Classical, Neo-classical, and Modern approaches, Functions of management – Planning, Organizing, Staffing, Directing, Controlling. Roles and responsibilities of managers, Nature and purpose of planning, Types of planning – Strategic, Tactical, Operational, Steps in planning process, Decision-making process – Types, techniques, and tools, Management by Objectives (MBO)

modules.title: Principles of Accounting
modules.content: Nature and Scope of Accounting, Double Entry System of Accounting, Introduction to Basic Books of Accounts of Sole Proprietary Concern, Closing of Books of Accounts and Preparation of Trial Balance.

modules.title: Final Accounts
modules.content: Trading, Profit and Loss Accounts and Balance Sheet of Sole Proprietary Concern with Normal Closing Entries. (with numerical problems)

modules.title: Ratio Analysis
modules.content: Meaning, Advantages, Limitations, Types of Ratio and Their Usefulness. (Theory only), Fund Flow Statement: Meaning of The Term Fund, Flow of Fund, Working Capital Cycle, Preparation and Inter-Preparation of Statement.

modules.title: Costing
modules.content: Nature, Importance and Basic Principles. Budget and Budgetary Control: Nature and Scope, Importance Method of Finalization, and Master Budget, Functional Budgets.

modules.title: Marginal Costing
modules.content: Nature, Scope, Importance, Construction of Break Even Chart, Limitations and Uses of Break Even Chart, Practical Applications of Marginal Costing.

modules.title: Organs of Governance

modules.title: Local Administration

Pachayati raj: Introduction, PRI: Zila Pachayat. Elected officials and their roles, CEO Zila Pachayat: Position and role. Block level: Organizational Hierarchy (Different departments), Village level: Role of Elected and Appointed officials, Importance of grass root democracy

modules.title: Election Commission
modules.content: Role and Functioning. Chief Election Commissioner and Election Commissioners. State Election Commission: Role and Functioning. Institute and Bodies for the welfare of SC/ST/OBC and women.

detailed_courses.title: Values and Ethics in Profession
detailed_courses.prerequisite: The prerequisite for Values and Ethics in Profession is a basic understanding of human values, social responsibility, and professional behaviour.

modules.content: History of Ethics – Need of Engineering Ethics – Senses of Engineering Ethics- Profession and Professionalism ––Self Interest – Moral Autonomy – Utilitarianism – Virtue Theory – Uses of Ethical Theories – Deontology- Types of Inquiry –Kohlberg’s Theory – Gilligan’s Argument – Heinz’s Dilemma – Comparison with Standard Experiments –– Learning from the Past – Engineers as Managers – Consultants and Leaders – Balanced Outlook on Law – Role of Codes – Codes and Experimental Nature of Engineering.

modules.content: Concept of Duty – Professional Duties – Collegiality – Techniques for Achieving Collegiality – Senses of Loyalty – Consensus and Controversy – Professional and Individual Rights – Confidential and Proprietary Information – Conflict of Interest-Ethical egoism – Collective Bargaining – Confidentiality – Gifts and Bribes – Problem solving-Occupational Crimes- Industrial Espionage- Price Fixing-Whistle Blowing

modules.title: Global issues
modules.content: Media Ethics – Environmental Ethics – Endangering Lives – Bio Ethics – Computer Ethics – War Ethics – Research Ethics - Intellectual Property Rights

detailed_courses.title: Managerial Economics
detailed_courses.prerequisite: The prerequisite for Managerial Economics is a basic understanding of microeconomics, mathematics, and analytical reasoning skills.

modules.title: Introduction to Economics
modules.content: Managerial Economics-Relationship with other disciplines -Firms: Types, Objectives and Scope of Economics, Managerial Decision Analysis

modules.title: Demand-Supply Framework & Equilibrium
modules.content: Demand and Supply: Determinants of demand, movements vs. shift in demand curve, Determinants of Supply, Movement along a supply curve vs. shift in supply curve; Market equilibrium and price determination. Elasticity of demand and supply, Application of demand and supply. Consumer Theory: Ordinal Utility theory: (Indifference curve approach): Consumer’s preferences; Indifference curves; Budget line; Consumer’s equilibrium.

modules.title: Theory of Production and Costs
modules.content: concept of Production function, types of Production function, Laws of return to scale and variable Proportion, Cost Function, Types of Cost Function, Different Cost curves, Relation between Average and marginal cost, Relationship between Short Run costs and Long Run costs, Cost volume profit analysis and application

modules.title: Selected Macroeconomic Principles
modules.content: Introduction to Macroeconomic Variables – Circular Flow of Income – Closed and Open Economy Models - Saving-Investment Identity. National income and different technique to measure of national income inflation: Inflation – Causes, Measurement, Effect, Measures to Control Inflation.

modules.title: Financial Accounting and Financial management
modules.content: Accounting Basic concept of Journal, Trading A/C, Profit& Loss A/C, Balance Sheet and the concept of time value of money (application of all factors of time value of money) & Capital budgeting technique.

modules.title: Market Structure
modules.content: Classification of Different Markets (Concepts only) – Perfect Competition, Monopoly, Monopolistic Competition, Monopsony and Oligopoly. Perfect Competition: Assumption; Theory of a firm under perfect competition; Demand and Revenue; Equilibrium of the firm in the short run and long run. Monopoly: Short-run and long-run equilibrium of monopoly firm; Price discrimination.

detailed_courses.title: Relational Database Management System Lab
detailed_courses.prerequisite: Basic knowledge of database concepts, data models, and SQL.

modules.title: Database Creation & DDL/DML
modules.content: ERD to Relational Model implementation, Table creation, altering schema, applying constraints (Primary Key, Foreign Key, Unique, Not Null, Check), Using data dictionary views for verification, Creating Views and Materialized Views, DML operations: Insert, Update, Delete.

modules.title: Query Processing & Retrieval (DQL)
modules.content: Basic Select queries with conditions, sorting, and pattern matching, Joins: Equi, Non-Equi, Natural, Self, Inner, Outer, Set Operations: Union, Intersect, Minus, Single row and group functions, Aggregation with Group By, Having, Rollup, and Cube, Nested Subqueries and Correlated Subqueries.

modules.title: PL/SQL Programming
modules.content: Control structures: IF-THEN-ELSE, Loops, Stored Procedures and Functions, Cursors: Implicit, Explicit, Parameterized, Triggers: Before, After, instead of; row-level and statement-level, Transaction validation and rollback using triggers, Packages and Exception Handling.

modules.title: Mini Project
modules.content: Design and implement a complete database system for a real-life application using SQL & PL/SQL concepts.

detailed_courses.title: Soft Skill and Interpersonal Development
detailed_courses.prerequisite: Basic ability of soft skills.

modules.title: Introduction to Soft Skills
modules.content: The Skills of Interpersonal Communication. 2. Team Behavior. 3. Time Management Skills

modules.title: Verbal Ability - Reading
modules.content: Enhancing reading speed and vocabulary enhancement through intensive practice of placement test- based reading passages.

modules.title: Verbal Ability Test Patterns
modules.content: Introducing Verbal Ability tests—Test Question Types: Synonyms and Antonyms, Error Spotting /Sentence Improvement, Analogies and Para Jumbles.

modules.title: Group Discussion and Personal Interview
modules.content: Basics of Group Discussion—Intensive practice on answering interview-based questions common in placement interviews.

modules.title: Introduction to Python Programming
modules.content: History and features of Python, Installing Python, Writing and executing Python programs, Basic syntax, identifiers, keywords, and indentation rules. Variables, data types (numbers, strings, lists, tuples, dictionaries, sets), and type conversion, Input/Output operations, comments, and basic coding standards.

modules.title: Control Structures and Functions
modules.content: Decision making: if, if-else, if-elif-else statements, Loops: for, while, nested loops, break, continue, pass, Functions: Defining functions, arguments (positional, keyword, default, variable-length), return values, Lambda functions, scope of variables (local, global, nonlocal), Recursion in Python.

modules.title: Data Structures and String Handling
modules.content: Lists: Creation, indexing, slicing, operations, list comprehension, Tuples and Sets: Properties, operations, and use cases, Dictionaries: Key-value pairs, dictionary methods, nested dictionaries, String handling: String methods, slicing, formatting, regular expressions (RegEx), Iterators and Generators in Python.

modules.title: File Handling and Exception Management
modules.content: File operations: Opening, reading, writing, appending, closing files, Handling text and binary files, Exception handling: try, except, else, finally, raise, Creating custom exceptions.

modules.title: Object-Oriented Programming in Python
modules.content: Classes and objects, constructors (init method), Attributes and methods, class variables vs. instance variables, Inheritance: Single, multiple, and multilevel inheritance, Method overriding, polymorphism, encapsulation, abstraction, Special methods (str, len, operator overloading).

modules.title: Advanced Python and Applications
modules.content: Modules and Packages: Importing modules, math, random, date time, os, sys, Virtual environments and pip package management, Python standard libraries (collections, iter tools, func tools), Introduction to NumPy and Pandas for data analysis, Python in real-world applications: Web scraping, simple GUI (Tkinter), basics of Flask/Django, and automation scripts.

detailed_courses.title: Data Structures
detailed_courses.prerequisite: The prerequisite for Data Structures is a basic understanding of programming fundamentals and problem-solving using a high-level language such as C.

modules.title: Foundations of Data Structures & Linear Representation
modules.content: Introduction: Data, Data Type, Abstract Data Type (ADT), and Data Structure, Algorithms & Programs: Basics of pseudo-code, performance measurement, Algorithm Complexity: Time & Space analysis, Order Notations (Big-O, Ω, Θ),Memory Representations: Row-major, Column- major, Sparse matrices, Array Representation of Polynomials, Linked Lists: Singly, Doubly, Circular, Linked list representation of polynomial, Applications of Linked Lists in real systems (e.g., memory management).

modules.title: Stack, Queue & Recursion
modules.content: Stack: Implementations (array & linked list), applications (expression evaluation, undo/redo),Queue: Simple, Circular Queue, Dequeue (array & linked list implementations),Recursion: Principles, role of stack in recursion, tail vs non-tail recursion, Practical Use-cases: Parsing, backtracking, job scheduling,(NEW) Priority Queue & Applications in Operating Systems (process scheduling).

modules.title: Trees & Advanced Trees
modules.content: Tree Terminologies, Representation (array, linked list),Binary Trees: Traversals (pre, in, post), Expression Trees, Threaded Binary Tree: Concepts & Non-recursive traversals, Binary Search Trees: Operations (insertion, deletion, searching),Balanced Trees: AVL Trees (insert/delete with examples),B-Trees & B+ Trees (used in DBMS, indexing),(NEW) Introduction to Tries (Prefix Trees) for fast string searching, Applications of Trees in Compilers, Databases, and File Systems.

modules.title: Graphs & Applications
modules.content: Graph Representations: Adjacency matrix, Adjacency list, Graph Traversals: BFS, DFS, Classification of Edges in DFS, Minimum Spanning Trees: Prim’s and Kruskal’s Algorithm, Shortest Path Algorithms: Dijkstra’s Algorithm, Introduction to Bellman-Ford, Real-world Applications: Social Networks, Navigation Systems, Web Crawling.

modules.title: Searching, Sorting & Hashing
modules.content: Searching: Sequential, Binary, Interpolation Search, Sorting: Bubble Sort, Insertion Sort, Selection Sort, Merge Sort, Quick Sort, Heap Sort, Intro to Hybrid Sorting (e.g., TimSort – used in Python/Java), Hashing: Hash functions, Collision resolution (chaining, open addressing), Applications of Hashing in Databases, Compilers, Blockchain.

detailed_courses.title: Data Communication & Computer Networks

modules.title: Introduction
modules.content: Introduction to Data Communication, Components of Communication, Direction of data flow (simplex, half duplex, full duplex), Network topology, categories of network (LAN, MAN, WAN).

modules.title: Protocol and Standard
modules.content: Layered Task, The OSI model, TCP/ IP protocol suite, Comparison of OSI and TCP/IP model, Protocols used in various layers. Physical, Logical and Port Addressing.

modules.title: Internetworking

modules.title: Quality of Service
modules.content: Data traffic, Congestion, Principle of congestion control (Open Loop and Close Loop), Quality of service, Leaky bucket and Token bucket Algorithm, Techniques to improve QoS, Integrated services, Differentiated service, QoS in Frame Relay, QoS in ATM

modules.title: Application Layer protocols
modules.content: Name Space, Domain Name System, Distribution of Name Space, Remote Logging, Electronic Mail and File Transfer, WWW, Web document and HTTP, Network Management, Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP)

modules.title: Network Security
modules.content: Concept of Cryptography, Symmetric Key Cryptography, Diffie-Hellman key agreement, Man in the middle attack, DES, AES, Asymmetric Key Cryptography, RSA, Security Services, Digital Signature, Key Management, IP Security, SSL/TLS, PGP, Firewalls

detailed_courses.title: Numerical and Statistical Analysis

modules.title: Approximation in Numerical Computation
modules.content: Truncation and rounding errors; fixed and floating-point arithmetic; propagation of errors.

modules.title: Interpolation & Approximation
modules.content: Newton forward/backward interpolation; Lagrange’s and Newton’s divided difference interpolation.

modules.title: Numerical Integration
modules.content: Trapezoidal rule; Simpson’s 1/3 rule; Weddle’s integration; Gaussian quadrature; error terms.

modules.title: Numerical Solution of Linear Equations
modules.content: Gauss elimination method; LU factorization method; Gauss-Seidel iterative method, SOR method.

modules.title: Numerical Solution of Algebraic Equations
modules.content: Bisection method; Regula-Falsi method; Newton-Raphson method; Iteration method; Secant method.

modules.title: Numerical Solution of Ordinary Differential Equations
modules.content: Euler’s method; Runge-Kutta methods; Taylor’s series method; Predictor-Corrector methods; finite difference method.

modules.title: Introduction to Statistics & Probability
modules.content: Measures of central tendency and dispersion; probability concepts; distributions (Binomial, Poisson, Normal); moment generating functions; law of large numbers; Central Limit Theorem.

modules.title: Least Square Curve Fitting
modules.content: Linear & non-linear curve fitting; correlation and regression basics.

modules.title: Introduction
modules.content: Overview of Computer Graphics, Computer Graphics Application and Software, Description of some graphics devices, Input Devices for Operator Interaction, Active and Passive Graphics Devices, Display Technologies, Storage Tube Graphics Displays, Calligraphic Refresh Graphics Displays, Raster Refresh (Raster-Scan) Graphics Displays, Cathode Ray Tube Basics, Color CRT Raster Scan Basics, Video Basics, The Video Controller, Random Scan Display Processor, LCD displays.

modules.title: Graphics Primitives
modules.content: Points, Lines and Circles as primitives, Scan conversion algorithms for primitives, Output primitives: Points and lines, line drawing algorithms, mid-point circle and ellipse algorithms.
